experiment: K50: VRP Factor Control for VT Alpha
description: Test whether Volatility Risk Premium (VRP = VIX²/252 - RV) explains additional variance in VT returns beyond TSMOM. Motivated by Gemini review of K46.
conclusions: VRP β 的 t-stat: 1.94 (不顯著)
TSMOM β_t: M2=20.07 → M3=20.59 (加入 VRP 後仍顯著)
最佳 AIC 模型: M10_full, 最佳 BIC 模型: M10_full
VIX level (M8) adj_R²=0.8735 vs VRP (M4) adj_R²=0.8731: VIX level 更好
